svg.title: Different estimates of the same slowdown.
svg.desc: Four calculated braking-distance curves: no aerodynamics, the one-interval aero bound, eight conservative intervals, and the analytical aero solution. Subdivision approaches the analytical curve.

g.text: Different estimates of the same slowdown.
Illustrative coefficients: a₀ = 6 m/s², b = 0.002 /m, final speed = 15 m/s
Generated from the equations. These curves are not measured TORCS braking runs.
